items.name: frame
items.title: Frame
items.description: A tinted surface with a header, a raised panel and a footer. Children respond to the frame's own width through the @container/frame container (@sm/frame:, @max-lg/frame:, ...). Ships the two tokens it needs beyond stock shadcn (fill-1 and shadow-2xs, SortUI values) so it works without the SortUI theme.
items.author: Aiden Zepp

items.name: frame-overflow
items.title: Frame overflow
items.description: useFrameOverflow: lets a Frame header collapse low-priority actions (hidden by @container/frame queries) into its overflow menu. Pair with frame; menu primitives are your own.
items.author: Aiden Zepp
items.docs: Mark inline groups with data-overflow="name" and a frame container query such as @max-lg/frame:hidden, put triggerRef on the menu trigger and onOpenChange on the menu, then render hidden.name actions inside the menu.
